name: proofpoint_trap_note_upsert
description: Write a case note by title, updated in place: nothing when the content is unchanged, an update when it changed, a new note when none exists. Content over 20,000 characters is split into parts "title (k/N)"; parts left over from a longer earlier version are blanked as "title (unused)".

inputs.name: container_id
inputs.description: Case to write the note on.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Note title; identifies the note on the case.

outputs.description: True when a note was created, updated or blanked.
Ids of the notes holding the content, in part order.
Number of notes the content takes.
